93: ## 2. 已核验的原厂协议
94: 
95: ### 2.1 最终配置和初始化链
96: 
97: 当前生成配置：
98: 
99: ```text
100: AP reference:
101:   CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_AP=y
102:   CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_HOST_ONLY=y

106: CP final:

110:   CONFIG_BTDM_CONTROLLER_ONLY=y
111:   CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_SUPPORT_IPC=y
112: ```
113: 
114: 证据：
115: 
116: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/config/sdkconfig.h`
117: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/config/sdkconfig.h`
118: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/app.map`
119: 
120: 原 AP 顺序是 `bt_ipc_init()`、vendor INIT、AP OS/feature adapter、HCI driver、
121: Armino Host。OpenVela 替换 AP Host 和 AP OS adapter，不改变 CP controller 所有权。
122: 当前 CP 在系统 `bk_init()` 阶段已经调用 `bk_bluetooth_init()`；因此 AP vendor INIT
123: 在当前固件上通常是幂等同步握手，不应描述成必然首次启动 controller。
124: 
125: ### 2.2 logical channel
126: 
127: ```text
128: AP -> CP: MB_CHNL_BT_CMD = 0x13
129: CP -> AP: MB_CHNL_BT_CMD = 0x43
130: ```
131: 
132: 编码为 `destination[7:6] | source[5:4] | logical-id[3:0]`。依据：
133: 
134: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h`
135: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h`
136: - AP/CP `components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c`
137: 
138: ### 2.3 16-byte HCI descriptor ABI
139: 
140: 原厂定义：
141: 
142: ```c
143: struct bk7258_bt_descriptor
144: {
145:   uint32_t header;       /* offset 0, cmd/state/ctrl/seq/channel */
146:   uint8_t  packet_type;  /* offset 4 */
147:   uint8_t  pointer[4];   /* offset 5, little-endian, unaligned */
148:   uint8_t  reserved[7];  /* offset 9, must be zero in OpenVela */
149: } __attribute__((packed));
150: ```
151: 
152: packet type：
153: 
154: ```text
155: HCI_COMMAND_PKT  = 0x01
156: HCI_ACL_DATA_PKT = 0x02
157: HCI_SCO_DATA_PKT = 0x03
158: HCI_EVENT_PKT    = 0x04
159: HCI_FREE_PKT     = 0x0a
160: ```
161: 
162: 原 `hci_hdr_t` 是 9 字节，`hdr_ptr` offset 为 5；它与 16 字节
163: `bt_ipc_cmd_t/mb_chnl_cmd_t` union 共用存储。所有 OpenVela TX descriptor 必须先
164: 清零完整 16 字节，`header.cmd` 固定为 0，再由 Mailbox 层填 state、ctrl、seq 和
165: channel。pointer 必须用 `memcpy` 或逐字节 helper 访问，不能对 packed offset 5
166: 执行未对齐 `uint32_t` 解引用。
167: 
168: 当前 `struct bk7258_mb_wire_message` 的 offset 4 是 `payload_address`，offset 8
169: 是 `payload_length`，与上述 BT descriptor 不兼容。BT 代码不得把 pointer 写入
170: `message.payload_address`。必须增加 raw 16-byte overlay/accessor；通用 message
171: 和 BT descriptor 只能共享 header 以及“总长 16 字节”这一事实。
172: 
173: 建议在 `hardware/bk7258_bt_ipc.h` 固定：
174: 
175: ```c
176: union bk7258_mb_frame
177: {
178:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message generic;
179:   struct bk7258_bt_descriptor bt;
180:   uint8_t raw[BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE];
181: };
182: 
183: _Static_assert(sizeof(union bk7258_mb_frame) == 16, "mailbox frame size");
184: _Static_assert(offsetof(struct bk7258_bt_descriptor, packet_type) == 4,
185:                "BT packet type offset");
186: _Static_assert(offsetof(struct bk7258_bt_descriptor, pointer) == 5,
187:                "BT pointer offset");
188: ```
189: 
190: Mailbox transport内部存储、send 和 RX callback改用 `union bk7258_mb_frame`，或提供
191: 等价的 raw 16-byte API。对非 BT channel 继续使用 `.generic`；对 `0x13/0x43`
192: 只使用 `.bt/.raw`，不得读取 `payload_length/flags/crc8`。
193: 
194: ### 2.4 payload 和三类完成语义
195: 
196: descriptor 只携带 pointer，实际 HCI payload 位于发送方可被另一核访问的内存：
197: 
198: ```c
199: struct hci_cmd  { le16 opcode; u8 len; u8 params[]; } packed;
200: struct hci_evt  { u8 event; u8 len; u8 params[]; } packed;
201: struct hci_acl  { le16 handle_flags; le16 len; u8 data[]; } packed;
202: ```
203: 
204: 三类完成语义不能混用：
205: 
206: 1. Mailbox ACK：对端 logical layer 已复制 16-byte descriptor。
207: 2. Beken `HCI_FREE_PKT`：对端已处理 wrapper，原分配方可以回收 pointer。
208: 3. HCI Complete/Status 或 Number Of Completed Packets：controller 协议结果/credit。
209: 
210: AP/CP 收到 Event、Command 或 ACL wrapper后会向原分配方回发
211: `HCI_FREE_PKT(pointer)`。收到 FREE 的原厂 CP 会直接 `os_free(pointer)`，所以 AP
212: 不能把一个未经白名单验证的 CP pointer原样回发给 CP。
213: 
214: ### 2.5 vendor INIT ABI
215: 
216: ```text
217: HCI vendor opcode: 0xfefe
218: INIT sub-opcode:    0x0001
219: DEINIT sub-opcode:  0x0002
220: 
221: AP -> CP INIT params:       00 01
222: CP -> AP vendor event data: 01 00 status
223: ```
224: 
225: 两条路径的 sub-opcode 字节序不同，必须逐字节编码：
226: 
227: - AP 发送 `[subop >> 8, subop & 0xff]`。
228: - CP 回复 `[subop & 0xff, subop >> 8, status]`。
229: 
230: CP 回复是 event code `0xfe`，不是普通 HCI Command Complete。transport在 Host
231: 初始化前拦截该 event、验证长度和 sub-opcode、更新 ready状态并 FREE CP wrapper；
232: 不能把它直接提交给尚未 ready 的 NuttX Host。
233: 
234: ## 3. 当前实现状态和真正缺口
235: 
236: 当前 OpenVela 已具备：
237: 
238: - CPU1 MBOX0 channel 1 FIFO、IRQ79 和 16-byte descriptor deferral。
239: - `bk7258_mailbox_send_wire()` 通用异步发送和 TX complete callback。
240: - `bk7258_mailbox_register_rx()` per-channel RX callback。
241: - 8 个稳定 ACK slots，ACK 优先于 reset 和普通 command。
242: - 单 active transaction、每 logical channel 一个 pending slot。
243: - 200 ms timeout、link reset/probe、`peer_reset_generation`。
244: - CP SRAM `0x28064000..0x2809f6ff` non-cacheable/shareable MPU 映射。
245: 
246: 证据位于：
247: 
248: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_mbox.h`
249: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c`
250: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c`

252: 不要重复实现上述能力。真正缺口是：
253: 
254: | 缺口 | 必须实现的结果 |
255: | --- | --- |
256: | BT channel ID | TX `0x13`、RX `0x43` 加入白名单和 callback table |
257: | raw frame | BT offset 4/5 ABI，不复用 generic payload字段 |
258: | 硬编码索引 | 删除 `g_channels[4]`，按 UART channel ID 查询索引 |
259: | BT TX queue | 在 generic transport之上增加有界优先级队列 |
260: | AP TX pool | 固定 AP SRAM wrapper，直到匹配 FREE 才复用 |
261: | CP pointer校验 | SRAM窗口、总长、overflow、type、重复 descriptor |
262: | RX worker | ISR只复制 descriptor，worker校验、copy、deliver、FREE |
263: | NuttX lower-half | `bt_driver_s`、Kconfig、Make/CMake、board bring-up |
264: | HCI恢复 | quarantine、DEINIT/INIT和明确的不可恢复边界 |
265: | 测试工具 | `btsak` 和可写/可通知的最小 GATT fixture |
266: 
267: 当前每个 logical channel 只有一个 pending slot，第二个请求返回 `-EBUSY`。BT 同一
268: channel需要发送 FREE、vendor command、HCI command和ACL，因此不能让 Host直接调用
269: `bk7258_mailbox_send_wire()`。否则 FREE 会被普通 command/ACL 阻塞，且 NuttX TX
270: 线程未必重试 lower-half 的 `-EBUSY`。

298: ## 5. Transport 设计
299: 
300: ### 5.1 Mailbox channel接入
301: 
302: 在原厂优先级顺序中，BT 位于 PWC 后、Wi-Fi 前：
303: 
304: ```text
305: HW_CTRL, PWC, BT, WIFI_CMD, WIFI_DATA, UART0
306: ```
307: 
308: 修改时同时更新 TX/RX count、ID数组、callback数组、统计和 dump。先把：
309: 
310: ```c
311: g_channels[4].queued
312: ```
313: 
314: 改为通过 `channel_index(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX)` 获取，避免插入 BT 后 probe
315: 检查错误 channel。
316: 
317: generic Mailbox层仍只负责：
318: 
319: - 赋 logical channel和sequence。
320: - 一次发送一个 descriptor。
321: - 匹配 transport ACK。
322: - timeout和link状态。
323: 
324: 它不理解 HCI payload，也不根据 `HCI_FREE_PKT` 回收内存。
325: 
326: ### 5.2 BT出站队列
327: 
328: `bk7258_bt_transport.c` 在 generic transport之上维护一个有界队列。建议初值：
329: 
330: ```text
331: CONFIG_BK7258_BT_TX_BUFFERS=8
332: CONFIG_BK7258_BT_TX_QUEUE=16
333: CONFIG_BK7258_BT_RX_QUEUE=16
334: ```
335: 
336: 队列优先级：
337: 
338: 1. 已验证 CP pointer 的 `HCI_FREE_PKT`。
339: 2. vendor INIT/DEINIT 和恢复控制。
340: 3. 标准 HCI Command。
341: 4. ACL。
342: 
343: 同一优先级保持 FIFO。必须为 FREE 和 Command 保留容量，ACL 不能占满所有项。
344: `bt_driver_s.send()` 在复制 payload并成功入队后返回 `len`；失败返回负 errno。
345: Command使用保留 slot或有界等待，ACL queue满返回 `-ENOBUFS`。任何路径都不能在
346: Mailbox ISR中等待 semaphore。
347: 
348: generic TX complete只表示 descriptor ACK：
349: 
350: - ACK成功：payload保持 `IN_FLIGHT`，等待 FREE。
351: - ACK失败且 descriptor确认未交给 CP：可回收 payload。
352: - timeout/结果不确定：payload进入 quarantine，不能立即复用。
353: 
354: ### 5.3 AP HCI TX pool
355: 
356: 第一版固定使用 AP SRAM中的静态小对象池，不使用任意 NuttX heap pointer，也不把
357: HCI pool放入 PSRAM。当前 AP SRAM和CP SRAM映射均为 non-cacheable，仍需在 B0
358: 通过 CP 实读证明 CPU0能访问 AP pool地址。
359: 
360: 每个对象记录：
361: 
362: ```text
363: state, generation, wire_address, packet_type, length, enqueue_time
364: ```
365: 
366: 状态：
367: 
368: ```text
369: FREE -> BUILDING -> QUEUED -> IN_FLIGHT -> FREE_RECEIVED -> FREE
370:                                   |
371:                                   +-> QUARANTINED
372: ```
373: 
374: 收到 `HCI_FREE_PKT` 时只能按 wire address查 ownership table。仅完全匹配当前
375: `IN_FLIGHT` 对象才回收；unknown、duplicate、旧 generation和非对象起始地址均记录
376: 错误并触发受控恢复，绝不调用 `kmm_free(remote_pointer)`。
377: 
378: ### 5.4 AP发送 Command/ACL
379: 
380: NuttX lower-half只接受 `BT_CMD` 和 `BT_ACL_OUT`：
381: 
382: ```text
383: send(type, data, len)
384:   -> 验证type、HCI header和len
385:   -> 从AP pool分配完整wrapper
386:   -> memcpy NuttX HCI header+payload，不添加H4 byte
387:   -> 构造清零的16-byte BT descriptor
388:   -> 入BT优先级队列
389:   -> 返回len
390:   -> generic mailbox发送并收到ACK
391:   -> 等CP发HCI_FREE_PKT
392:   -> ownership匹配后回收wrapper
393: ```
394: 
395: Host在 `send()` 返回后可以复用原 buffer，所以必须复制。HCI multi-byte字段使用
396: little-endian helper或 `memcpy`，不能直接访问 packed halfword。
397: 
398: ### 5.5 CP接收 Event/ACL
399: 
400: ```text
401: Mailbox IRQ / logical RX callback
402:   -> 只验证channel、descriptor type
403:   -> 复制完整16字节到BT RX queue
404:   -> 不解引用CP pointer
405: 
406: BT RX worker
407:   -> 解析unaligned pointer
408:   -> 验证pointer窗口和最小header
409:   -> 用memcpy读取Event/ACL length
410:   -> 验证pointer + total不overflow、不越窗口、不超Host上限
411:   -> 复制到本地临时buffer
412:   -> Event: bt_netdev_receive(driver, BT_EVT, data, total)
413:   -> ACL:   bt_netdev_receive(driver, BT_ACL_IN, data, total)
414:   -> 成功或Host明确拒绝后，为可信wrapper排队HCI_FREE_PKT
415: ```
416: 
417: 传给 NuttX 的 data从 Event/ACL header开始，不包含 H4 type。`bt_receive()` 自己会
418: 再次复制并投递 HPWORK/LPWORK，所以本地临时buffer在其返回后可释放。
419: 
420: RX queue必须保持原 descriptor顺序。不能为了“Event优先”越过先到的 ACL；NuttX
421: 在 `bt_receive()` 后已经会把 Command Complete/Status和 Number Of Completed
422: Packets投递 HPWORK。queue满时不能静默丢包：停止接收新业务、记录未释放可信
423: pointer并进入恢复；完全非法 pointer不回发 FREE，因为 CP会直接对收到的地址
424: 执行 `os_free()`。
425: 
426: ### 5.6 pointer、长度和Host上限
427: 
428: 第一阶段 CP outbound wrapper白名单先限定当前 CP SRAM：
429: 
430: ```text
431: 0x28064000 <= pointer < 0x2809f700
432: ```
433: 
434: 原因是当前 `bt_ipc_core` 使用 `os_malloc`，最终 CP开启 `CONFIG_MEM_DEBUG`，现有
435: 源码路径指向 CP SRAM allocator。只有 golden trace实际出现 PSRAM pointer且确认
436: allocator边界后，才能增加 PSRAM白名单。不能把整个 `0x60000000..0x60ffffff`
437: 直接设为可接受窗口。
438: 
439: 长度规则：
440: 
441: - Event total = `2 + param_len`。
442: - ACL total = `4 + little_endian(datalen)`。
443: - AP -> CP ACL上限来自 controller `LE Read Buffer Size`。
444: - CP -> AP ACL上限来自 AP发送的 `Host Buffer Size`。
445: - 两个方向还必须满足当前 NuttX `BLUETOOTH_MAX_FRAMELEN`。当前源码值为 79字节；
446:   driver在调用 `bt_netdev_receive()` 前必须显式检查，因为 `bt_receive()` copy前没有
447:   独立的传入长度上限保护。
448: - `param_len <= 255` 不是有效门禁，因为字段本身就是 `uint8_t`；真正门禁是总长、
449:   pointer窗口和Host buffer容量。
450: 
451: ### 5.7 四种流控统计
452: 
453: 分别统计，禁止合并：
454: 
455: - Mailbox descriptor ACK。
456: - Beken `HCI_FREE_PKT` wrapper回收。
457: - Controller `Number Of Completed Packets`，归还 AP -> CP ACL credit。
458: - Host `Host Number Of Completed Packets`，归还 CP -> AP ACL credit。
459: 
460: NuttX Host初始化还会发送 `Host Buffer Size` 和 `Set Controller To Host Flow Control`。
461: B2必须验证这些命令，不得只验证 `LE Read Buffer Size`。
462: 
463: ## 6. NuttX lower-half和生命周期
464: 
465: ### 6.1 Driver对象
466: 
467: ```c
468: static struct bt_driver_s g_bk7258_bt_driver =
469: {
470:   .head_reserve = 0,
471:   .open         = bk7258_bt_open,
472:   .send         = bk7258_bt_send,
473:   .close        = bk7258_bt_close,
474:   .ioctl        = NULL,
475:   .priv         = &g_bk7258_bt_priv,
476:   /* receive和bt_net由bt_netdev_register()填写。 */
477: };
478: ```
479: 
480: `head_reserve=0`，因为 Beken wrapper不使用H4 byte。第一版不启用
481: `CONFIG_DRIVERS_BLUETOOTH`，使 `bt_driver_register()` 直接映射到
482: `bt_netdev_register()`；当前 `CONFIG_DRIVERS_BLUETOOTH` wrapper的 unregister路径
483: 不适合作为恢复基础。
484: 
485: ### 6.2 唯一初始化顺序
486: 
487: 采用一个明确模型，不在 register前和 `open()` 中重复 INIT：
488: 
489: ```text
490: board late bring-up
491:   -> mailbox link READY
492:   -> PWC/heartbeat已启动
493:   -> bk7258_bt_transport_initialize()
494:        注册0x43 RX callback并启动TX/RX worker
495:   -> bt_driver_register(&g_bk7258_bt_driver)
496:        -> 注册层先填写driver.receive
497:        -> bt_initialize()
498:           -> driver.open()
499:              -> 发送vendor INIT
500:              -> transport拦截0xfe ready event
501:              -> 等待status==0和对应wrapper FREE完成/排队
502:              -> 返回OK
503:           -> NuttX立即执行标准HCI初始化
504:        -> bt_add_services()
505:           -> 注册GAP服务并自动开始advertising
506:        -> 注册bnep0
507: ```
508: 
509: `open()` 使用有界 5秒等待。timeout返回 `-ETIMEDOUT`，不能假装成功。vendor event
510: 只在 `open()` 的预Host状态拦截；ready后其他标准Event交给 NuttX。
511: 
512: `bt_netdev_register()` 当前会调用 `bt_add_services()` 并自动 advertising。因此阶段
513: B3的成功条件必须包括默认 advertising；不能写成“B3只初始化、B4才首次启动”。
514: 
515: ### 6.3 close和恢复
516: 
517: `close()`：
518: 
519: 1. 禁止新 Host send。
520: 2. 等待已知 in-flight payload有界清空。
521: 3. 发送 vendor DEINIT并等待匹配 event。
522: 4. 停止 BT worker或置为 quiesced。
523: 5. 有不确定 ownership 时保留 quarantine，不复用地址。
524: 
525: 当前 `bt_netdev_unregister()` 可以执行 Host deinitialize、driver close和netdev注销，
526: 但重注册仍需验证所有 NuttX全局状态可重复初始化。第一版恢复门禁是：
527: 
528: - 无连接、无in-flight payload时 DEINIT -> INIT 100次。
529: - 整机复位后重新初始化。
530: - CP明确整核复位后再回收旧 AP payload。
531: 
532: 仅收到 Mailbox RESET/control generation不等于 CP controller已停止访问旧 pointer，
533: 不得据此清空 quarantine。
534:

595: ## 8. 分阶段实施和验收
596: 
597: ### B0：冻结输入和ABI
598: 
599: 输出一份同日记录，包含：
600: 
601: - CP `app.bin`、`app.map`、`sdkconfig.h` SHA256。
602: - 实际 controller archive名称。
603: - AP/CP toolchain下 descriptor `sizeof/offsetof`。
604: - vendor INIT/DEINIT逐字节 trace。
605: - CP Event/ACL pointer实际分布。
606: - controller LE ACL最大长度和数量。
607: - AP SRAM pool地址被 CP实际读取成功的证明。
608: 
609: 这些未完成前不注册 NuttX Host。
610: 
611: ### B1：raw BT logical transport
612: 
613: 实现 `0x13/0x43`、raw frame、UART索引修复、BT TX/RX queue和统计。由于正式 CP
614: 没有任意 BT descriptor echo入口，不执行“无 HCI语义双向 loopback”：
615: 
616: - AP -> CP只对定义明确的 vendor INIT/HCI command做10,000次 descriptor ACK压力。
617: - CP -> AP通过真实 vendor event和Command Complete验证。
618: - 若要任意 descriptor echo，必须使用独立测试CP固件，不能写成“不修改CP”的正式门禁。
619: 
620: ### B2：完整raw HCI初始化
621: 
622: 暂不注册Host，测试入口按当前 `hci_initialize()` 顺序发送并检查真实status：
623: 
624: 1. vendor INIT。
625: 2. HCI Reset。
626: 3. Read Local Supported Features。
627: 4. Read Local Version Information。
628: 5. Read BD_ADDR。
629: 6. LE Read Local Supported Features。
630: 7. LE Read Buffer Size。
631: 8. Set Event Mask。
632: 9. LE Set Event Mask。
633: 10. Host Buffer Size。
634: 11. Set Controller To Host Flow Control。
635: 12. 若controller报告BR/EDR能力，再测 Read Buffer Size和LE Write Host Supported。
636: 13. 收到ACL后验证 Host Number Of Completed Packets。
637: 
638: 每条命令记录 opcode、transport ACK、FREE、Command Complete/Status和status；不得用
639: ACK代替HCI成功。
640: 
641: ### B3：注册NuttX Host
642: 
643: - `open()` 完成唯一 vendor INIT握手。
644: - Host完整初始化无timeout。
645: - `ifconfig` 可看到 `bnep0`。
646: - 注册结束时默认 advertising已经成功。
647: - `System.map` 包含 `bk7258_bt_*`、`bt_netdev_register`、`bt_initialize`。
648: 
649: ### B4：advertising和scan
650: 
651: 实板NSH基线：
652: 
653: ```sh
654: bt bnep0 info
655: bt bnep0 features le
656: bt bnep0 advertise stop
657: bt bnep0 advertise start
658: bt bnep0 scan start -d
659: bt bnep0 scan get
660: bt bnep0 scan stop
661: ```
662: 
663: 手机使用 nRF Connect或等价工具确认 `VelaSights` 可发现。advertising stop/start
664: 重复100次；scan start/get/stop重复100次，前后 heap和pool计数回到基线。
665: 
666: ### B5：连接和GATT fixture
667: 
668: 内置 `bt_services.c` 只有GAP name/appearance read，不足以验收write和notification。
669: 在 board目录增加最小测试service，具备：
670: 
671: - 一个 read/write characteristic。
672: - 一个 notify characteristic。
673: - CCC descriptor。
674: - NSH命令触发一次或周期 notification。
675: 
676: 手机侧完成连接、service discovery、read、write、订阅CCC、notification、disconnect
677: 和reconnect。OpenVela作为client时使用：
678: 
679: ```sh
680: bt bnep0 gatt connect <addr> public
681: bt bnep0 gatt characteristic <addr> public
682: bt bnep0 gatt read <addr> public <handle>
683: bt bnep0 gatt write <addr> public <handle> <byte> [byte...]
684: bt bnep0 gatt disconnect <addr> public
685: ```
686: 
687: 地址类型按scan结果改为 `random`。验收同时检查双向ACL flow control和四类完成统计。
688: 
689: ### B6：稳定性、恢复和共存
690: 
691: - advertising/单连接运行72小时。
692: - connect/disconnect 1,000次。
693: - notification持续压力，queue/pool无净增长。
694: - Wi-Fi DHCP/TCP压力下 BLE不异常断开。
695: - BLE压力下 heartbeat、PWC、Mailbox UART无timeout。
696: - malformed/unknown/duplicate FREE全部拒绝且不破坏allocator。
697: - 无in-flight时 DEINIT/INIT 100次。
698: - 整机复位100次均重新出现 `bnep0` 和 advertising。
699: 
700: ### B7：SMP兼容复核
701: 
702: 不在本轮启用CPU2，但提交前检查：
703: 
704: - 无依赖 `up_cpu_index()==0` 才正确的未保护全局状态。
705: - ISR只做descriptor copy，worker/Host调用不在ISR。
706: - queue和ownership table同步在未来SMP下成立。
707: - 若未来启用 Host线程 affinity，配置中的 core编号按 NuttX逻辑CPU而非物理CPU解释。

780: ## 10. 诊断和安全门禁
781: 
782: 每类统计至少包含：
783: 
784: ```text
785: tx_enqueue, tx_ack, tx_timeout, tx_free, tx_free_unknown,
786: rx_event, rx_acl, rx_sco_rejected, rx_bad_pointer, rx_bad_length,
787: rx_queue_full, host_receive_error, vendor_timeout, recovery_count,
788: controller_completed, host_completed
789: ```
790: 
791: 故障定位顺序：
792: 
793: 1. 确认最终 CP配置、controller archive和CP `bt_ipc_core` hash。
794: 2. 确认 Mailbox link READY，BT TX `0x13`、RX `0x43` 已注册。
795: 3. 确认 vendor INIT event `fe 03 01 00 00` 的语义和对应 FREE。
796: 4. 区分 descriptor ACK、FREE和HCI Complete。
797: 5. 检查传给NuttX的数据不含H4 byte，Event从event code开始、ACL从handle开始。
798: 6. 检查 `BLUETOOTH_MAX_FRAMELEN`、CP pointer窗口和little-endian length。
799: 7. 检查 Command、ACL、FREE队列保留容量和ownership状态。
800: 8. 检查 Host Number Of Completed Packets与controller Number Of Completed Packets。
801: 
802: 安全规则：
803: 
804: - unknown FREE绝不直接free。
805: - 完全非法 CP pointer绝不原样FREE给CP。
806: - 可信CP wrapper即使SCO策略拒绝，也要安全排队FREE并记录拒绝。
807: - 任何 pointer加法先检查overflow。
808: - packed multi-byte字段只通过 `memcpy`/endian helper读取。
809: - 当前 `dmb sy` 只保证顺序；如果将来任一侧启用cache或把pool移到PSRAM，必须补
810:   clean/invalidate和明确的内存属性验证。
811: 
812: ## 11. 延后项和协议演进
813: 
814: ### 11.1 bond持久化
815: 
816: 当前 NuttX `bt_keys.c` 只使用静态RAM key pool；contest也没有可用的CP Flash proxy
817: bond backend。因此本轮可测试运行期 pairing/encryption，但不能把“重启后bond恢复”
818: 列为完成条件。后续必须先实现：
819: 
820: - CP Flash proxy channel和访问控制。
821: - key序列化版本、完整性和机密性。
822: - 掉电安全、磨损控制和加载/保存接口。
823: 
824: ### 11.2 独立复位恢复
825: 
826: 若要求 AP reset而CP继续运行，必须允许修改CP协议，至少增加：
827: 
828: - AP/CP BT generation或epoch。
829: - CP在AP generation变化时停止访问旧 AP pointer并重置BT IPC/controller。
830: - 显式 reset-ready handshake。
831: - 双方确认后统一回收旧pool。
832: 
833: 没有上述闭环时，AP reset会丢失 ownership table，CP仍可能访问同一 SRAM地址；
834: 任何“本地清表后继续”的实现都有 use-after-free/串包风险。
835: 
836: ### 11.3 OpenVela Bluetooth Framework
837: 
838: 产品若需要 Framework/SAL、QuickApp或NDK，另立方案同步对应仓库、服务进程、IPC、
839: 权限和Framework级测试；不得把本计划的 NuttX native Host验收冒充Framework完成。
840: 
841: ## 12. 完成定义
842: 
843: 满足以下条件才算完成本轮 BK7258 OpenVela Bluetooth移植：
844: 
845: - 当前CP继续运行唯一 BLE controller，OpenVela运行唯一Host。
846: - 本轮未改变CP `bt_ipc_core` wire ABI；当前项目级CP改动和输入hash已记录。
847: - `0x13/0x43`、BT raw offset 4/5和`HCI_FREE_PKT`与原厂兼容。
848: - generic Mailbox现有ACK/reset能力被复用，BT专用有界队列和ownership已实现。
849: - 所有远端pointer、length、type和FREE经过白名单及状态校验。
850: - vendor INIT只执行一条明确路径，完整NuttX HCI初始化成功。
851: - `bnep0`、默认advertising、scan、单连接和GATT read/write/notify通过实板验收。
852: - 四类完成/流控统计独立，Command和ACL无credit死锁。
853: - 72小时和共存压力无泄漏、double free、越界、永久busy和heartbeat/PWC回归。
854: - 无in-flight DEINIT/INIT和整机复位恢复通过门禁。
855: - AP raw、外部AP输入和最终`app1.bin`哈希一致。
856: 
857: AP单独复位无损恢复、bond掉电保存、OpenVela Bluetooth Framework、经典BT、SCO、
858: ISO、多连接和CPU2 SMP运行验收不属于本轮完成定义，必须按第11节另行闭环。

1508: /****************************************************************************
1509:  * Name: cmd_queue_deinit
1510:  *
1511:  * Description:
1512:  *   Threads, fifos and semaphores deinitialization
1513:  *
1514:  * Input Parameters:
1515:  *   none
1516:  *
1517:  * Returned Value:
1518:  *   None
1519:  *
1520:  ****************************************************************************/
1521: 
1522: static void cmd_queue_deinit(void)
1523: {
1524:   int ret;
1525:   FAR struct bt_buf_s *buf;
1526: 
1527:   /* Tell the tx thread that the module is disconnected.
1528:    */
1529: 
1530:   g_btdev.tx_status = ENOTCONN;
1531: 
1532:   /* Make sure the thread is not blocked by the semaphore.
1533:    */
1534: 
1535:   nxsem_post(&g_btdev.ncmd_sem);
1536: 
1537:   /* We create and push a packet into the tx queue to unblock the thread.
1538:    * Any packet will do.
1539:    */
1540: 
1541:   buf = bt_hci_cmd_create(BT_HCI_OP_RESET, 0);
1542:   if (buf)
1543:     {
1544:       ret = bt_queue_send(&g_btdev.tx_queue, buf, BT_NORMAL_PRIO);
1545:       if (ret < 0)
1546:         {
1547:           wlerr("ERROR: bt_queue_send() failed: %d\n", ret);
1548:         }
1549:     }
1550: 
1551:   /* Wait for the tx thread to exit gracefully. */
1552: 
1553:   while (g_btdev.tx_status == ENOTCONN)
1554:     {
1555:       nxsig_usleep(1000);
1556:     }
1557: 
1558:   /* Deinitialization */
1559: 
1560:   nxsem_destroy(&g_btdev.ncmd_sem);
1561:   file_mq_close(&g_btdev.tx_queue);
1562:   work_cancel(HPWORK, &g_hp_work);
1563:   work_cancel(LPWORK, &g_lp_work);
1564: }

1569: static void cmd_queue_init(void)

1571:   int ret;
1572: #ifdef CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_TXCMD_PINNED_TO_CORE
1573:   cpu_set_t cpuset;
1574: #endif
1575:   int pid;
1576: 
1577:   /* When there is a command to be sent to the Bluetooth driver, it queued on
1578:    * the Tx queue and received by logic on the Tx kernel thread.
1579:    */
1580: 
1581:   ret = bt_queue_open(BT_HCI_TX, O_RDWR | O_CREAT | O_CLOEXEC,
1582:                       CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_TXCMD_NMSGS, &g_btdev.tx_queue);
1583:   DEBUGASSERT(ret >= 0);
1584: 
1585:   nxsem_init(&g_btdev.ncmd_sem, 0, 1);
1586: 
1587:   g_btdev.ncmd = 1;
1588:   g_btdev.tx_status = OK;
1589: 
1590: #ifdef CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_TXCMD_PINNED_TO_CORE
1591:   sched_lock();
1592: #endif
1593: 
1594:   pid = kthread_create("BT HCI Tx", CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_TXCMD_PRIORITY,
1595:                        CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_TXCMD_STACKSIZE,
1596:                        hci_tx_kthread, NULL);
1597:   DEBUGASSERT(pid > 0);
1598: 
1599: #ifdef CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_TXCMD_PINNED_TO_CORE
1600:   CPU_ZERO(&cpuset);
1601:   CPU_SET((CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_TXCMD_CORE - 1), &cpuset);
1602:   ret = nxsched_set_affinity(pid, sizeof(cpuset), &cpuset);
1603:   if (ret)
1604:     {
1605:       wlerr("Failed to set affinity error=%d\n", ret);
1606:       DEBUGPANIC();
1607:     }
1608: 
1609:   sched_unlock();
1610: #endif
1611: 
1612:   UNUSED(ret);
1613: }

1795:  *   the radio.  This may be called from the low-level driver and is part of
1796:  *   the driver interface prototyped in
1797:  *   include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_driver.h
1798:  *
1799:  *   NOTE:  This function will defer all real work to the low or to the high
1800:  *   priority work queues.  Therefore, this function may safely be called
1801:  *   from interrupt handling logic.

1803:  * Input Parameters:

1811: int bt_receive(FAR struct bt_driver_s *btdev, enum bt_buf_type_e type,
1812:                FAR void *data, size_t len)
1813: {
1814:   FAR struct bt_hci_evt_hdr_s *hdr;
1815:   struct bt_buf_s *buf;
1816:   int ret;
1817: 
1818:   wlinfo("data %p len %zu\n", data, len);
1819: 
1820:   /* Critical command complete/status events use the high priority work
1821:    * queue.
1822:    */
1823: 
1824:   buf = bt_buf_alloc(type, NULL, BLUETOOTH_H4_HDRLEN);
1825:   if (buf == NULL)
1826:     {
1827:       return -ENOMEM;
1828:     }
1829: 
1830:   memcpy(bt_buf_extend(buf, len), data, len);
1831: 
1832:   if (type != BT_ACL_IN)
1833:     {
1834:       if (type != BT_EVT)
1835:         {
1836:           wlerr("ERROR: Invalid buf type %u\n", buf->type);
1837:           bt_buf_release(buf);
1838:           return -EINVAL;
1839:         }
1840: 
1841:       /* Command Complete/Status events use high priority messages. */
1842: 
1843:       hdr = (FAR void *)buf->data;
1844:       if (hdr->evt == BT_HCI_EVT_CMD_COMPLETE ||
1845:           hdr->evt == BT_HCI_EVT_CMD_STATUS ||
1846:           hdr->evt == BT_HCI_EVT_NUM_COMPLETED_PACKETS)
1847:         {
1848:           /* Add the buffer to the high priority Rx buffer list */
1849: 
1850:           bt_enqueue_bufwork(&g_hp_rxlist, buf);
1851: 
1852:           /* If there is already pending work, then do nothing.  Otherwise,
1853:            * schedule processing of the Rx buffer list on the high priority
1854:            * work queue.
1855:            */
1856: 
1857:           if (work_available(&g_hp_work))
1858:             {
1859:               ret = work_queue(HPWORK, &g_hp_work, priority_rx_work,
1860:                                &g_hp_rxlist, 0);
1861:               if (ret < 0)
1862:                 {
1863:                   wlerr("ERROR:  Failed to schedule HPWORK: %d\n", ret);
1864:                 }
1865:             }
1866: 
1867:           return OK;
1868:         }
1869:     }

141: 		performance.

145: 	default 0

147: 		If buffer structures can be allocated from interrupt handlers, then
148: 		this specifies the number of pre-allocated structures that are
149: 		reserved for for use only by interrupt handlers.  This may be set
150: 		zero to reserve no buffers for interrupt handlers. In that case,
151: 		the allocation will fail if tasking logic has allocated them all.

1: #
2: # For a description of the syntax of this configuration file,
3: # see the file kconfig-language.txt in the NuttX tools repository.
4: #
5: 
6: menu "Bluetooth socket support"
7: 
8: config NET_BLUETOOTH
9: 	bool "Bluetooth socket support"
10: 	default n
11: 	depends on WIRELESS_BLUETOOTH
12: 	select NETDEV_IOCTL
13: 	---help---
14: 		Enable support for raw, Bluetooth sockets.
15: 
16: 		Raw sockets allow receiving and transmitting Bluetooth radio
17: 		frames without a layer2 protocol such as 6LoWPAN in between. Frames
18: 		received are copied into a Bluetooth socket tap before they
19: 		enter the network. Frames written into a Bluetooth socket will
20: 		bypass the network altogether and will be sent directly to the
21: 		Bluetooth MAC network interface driver outgoing frame queue.
22: 
23: if NET_BLUETOOTH
24: 
25: config NET_BLUETOOTH_PREALLOC_CONNS
26: 	int "Preallocated Bluetooth sockets"
27: 	default 4
28: 	---help---
29: 		Number of Bluetooth connections (all tasks).
30: 
31: 		This number of connections will be pre-allocated during system boot.
32: 		If dynamic connections allocation is enabled, more connections may
33: 		be allocated at a later time, as the system needs them. Else this
34: 		will be the maximum number of connections available to the system
35: 		at all times.
36: 
37: 		Set to 0 to disable (and rely only on dynamic allocations).
38: 
39: config NET_BLUETOOTH_ALLOC_CONNS
40: 	int "Dynamic Bluetooth connections allocation"
41: 	default 0
42: 	---help---
43: 		Dynamic memory allocations for Bluetooth.
44: 
45: 		When set to 0 all dynamic allocations are disabled.
46: 
47: 		When set to 1 a new connection will be allocated every time,
48: 		and it will be free'd when no longer needed.
49: 
50: 		Setting this to 2 or more will allocate the connections in
51: 		batches (with batch size equal to this config). When a
52: 		connection is no longer needed, it will be returned to the
53: 		free connections pool, and it will never be deallocated!
54: 
55: config NET_BLUETOOTH_MAX_CONNS
56: 	int "Maximum number of Bluetooth connections"
57: 	default 0
58: 	depends on NET_BLUETOOTH_ALLOC_CONNS > 0
59: 	---help---
60: 		If dynamic connections allocation is selected (NET_BLUETOOTH_ALLOC_CONNS > 0)
61: 		this will limit the number of connections that can be allocated.
62: 
63: 		This is useful in case the system is under very heavy load (or
64: 		under attack), ensuring that the heap will not be exhausted.
65: 
66: config NET_BLUETOOTH_NCONTAINERS
67: 	int "Number of pre-allocated frame containers"
68: 	default 8
69: 	---help---
70: 		This specifies the total number of preallocated frame containers.
71: 		One must be allocated with each incoming frame.
72: 
73: config NET_BLUETOOTH_BACKLOG
74: 	int "Maximum frame backlog"
75: 	default 8
76: 	range 0 255
77: 	---help---
78: 		As frames are received, they are held in an RX queue.  They remain
79: 		in the RX queue until application logic reads the queue frames.  To
80: 		prevent overrun, the maximum backlog may be set to a nonzero value.
81: 		When the backlog of queue frames reaches that count, the old frame
82: 		will be freed, preventing overrun at the cost of losing the oldest
83: 		frames.
84: 
85: 		NOTE: The special value of zero will disable all backlog checks.
86: 
87: endif # NET_BLUETOOTH
88: endmenu # Bluetooth Socket Support

223: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
224:                      uint32_t *order)
225: {
226:   uint32_t wire[2];
227:   int ret;
228: 
229:   *order = ++g_send_order;
230:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
231:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
232:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
233:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
234:   if (ret == OK)
235:     {
236:       g_stats.tx++;
237:     }
238:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
239:     {
240:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
241:     }
242: 
243:   if (ret < 0)
244:     {
245:       g_stats.last_tx_error = (uint32_t)(-ret);
246:     }
247: 
248:   return ret;
249: }

286: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
287:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
288:                                  int result)
289: {
290:   struct logical_channel *channel = NULL;

292:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)

295:       channel->queued = false;
296:       channel->result = result;
297:     }

299:   active->busy = false;
300:   if (result == OK)
301:     {
302:       release_acks_before(active->order);
303:     }
304: 
305:   if (active->callback != NULL)
306:     {
307:       active->callback(ack, result, active->arg);

342: static void select_recovery_epoch(void)
343: {
344:   unsigned int i;
345:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = NULL;
346: 
347:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
348:     {
349:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
350:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
351:         {
352:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
353:           g_recovery_index = i;
354:           break;
355:         }
356:     }
357: 
358:   if (epoch == NULL)
359:     {
360:       uint32_t newest = 0;
361: 
362:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
363:         {
364:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
365:             {
366:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
367:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
368:               g_recovery_index = i;
369:             }
370:         }
371: 
372:       epoch->replay = true;
373:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
374:     }
375:   else
376:     {
377:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
378:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
379:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
380:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
381:     }
382: 
383:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
384:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
385:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
386:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
387:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
388: }

390: static void begin_abort(int result)
391: {
392:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
393: 
394:   if (g_active.busy)
395:     {
396:       g_active.quarantine = true;
397:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
398:     }
399: 
400:   if (probe != NULL)
401:     {
402:       probe->quarantine = true;
403:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
404:     }
405: 
406:   fail_pending(result);
407:   g_probe_requested = false;
408:   select_recovery_epoch();
409: }

411: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
412: {
413:   unsigned int i;
414: 
415:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
416:     {
417:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
418:         {
419:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
420:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
421:         }
422:     }
423: 
424:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
425:   return NULL;

428: static int dispatch_locked(void)
429: {
430:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
431:   struct active_transaction *active;
432:   struct logical_channel *channel;
433:   unsigned int i;
434:   int ret;
435: 
436:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
437: 
438:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
439:     {
440:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
441:         {
442:           continue;
443:         }
444: 
445:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
446:       if (ret < 0)
447:         {
448:           return ret;
449:         }
450: 
451:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
452:     }
453: 
454:   if (g_reset_pending)
455:     {
456:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
457:       if (ret < 0)
458:         {
459:           return ret;
460:         }
461: 
462:       g_reset_pending = false;
463:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
464:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
465:     }
466: 
467:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
468:     {
469:       return OK;
470:     }
471: 
472:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
473:     {
474:       channel = &g_channels[i];
475:       if (!channel->queued)
476:         {
477:           continue;
478:         }
479: 
480:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
481:         {
482:           if (g_channel_ids[i] == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
483:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) ==
484:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
485:             {
486:               active = &epoch->probe;
487:             }
488:           else
489:             {
490:               continue;
491:             }
492: 
493:           if (active == &epoch->probe && active->quarantine &&
494:               !epoch->replay)
495:             {
496:               return -ENOLINK;
497:             }
498:         }
499:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
500:         {
501:           active = &g_active;
502:           if (active->quarantine)
503:             {
504:               return -ENOLINK;
505:             }
506:         }
507:       else
508:         {
509:           return OK;
510:         }
511: 
512:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
513:         {
514:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
515:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
516:                  sizeof(active->message));
517:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
518:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
519:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
520:             g_channel_ids[i]);
521:         }
522: 
523:       active->callback = channel->callback;
524:       active->arg = channel->arg;
525:       active->channel_index = i;
526:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
527:       active->busy = true;
528:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
529:       if (ret < 0)
530:         {
531:           active->busy = false;
532:           return ret;
533:         }
534: 
535:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
536:         {
537:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
538:             {
539:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
540:             }
541: 
542:           g_probe_attempts++;
543:           g_stats.probes++;
544:         }
545: 
546:       return OK;
547:     }
548: 
549:   return OK;
550: }

552: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
553:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
554:   const struct active_transaction *active)
555: {
556:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
557:   uint32_t reason = 0;
558: 
559:   if (!active->busy)
560:     {
561:       return 1u;
562:     }
563: 
564:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
565:     {
566:       reason |= 2u;
567:     }
568:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
569:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
570:     {
571:       reason |= 4u;
572:     }
573:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
574:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
575:     {
576:       reason |= 8u;
577:     }
578:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
579:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
580:     {
581:       reason |= 16u;
582:     }
583: 
584:   return reason;
585: }

587: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
588: {
589:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
590:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
591:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
592: }
593: 
594: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
595: {
596:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
597:   struct active_transaction *active;
598:   bool replay;
599:   int result;
600:   uint32_t reason;
601: 
602: 
603:   active = busy_probe();
604:   if (active == NULL)
605:     {
606:       active = &g_active;
607:     }
608: 
609:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
610:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
611:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
612:   if (reason != 0)
613:     {
614:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
615:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
616:       return;
617:     }
618: 
619: 
620:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
621:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
622:     {
623:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
624: 
625:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
626:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
627:       return;
628:     }
629: 
630:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
631:     {
632:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
633:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
634:       return;
635:     }
636: 
637:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
638:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
639: 
640:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
641:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
642:     {
643:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
644:     }
645: 
646:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
647:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
648:   if (replay)
649:     {
650:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
651:       unsigned int i;
652: 
653:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
654:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
655:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
656:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
657:        */
658: 
659:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
660:       g_active.quarantine = false;
661:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
662:         {
663:           if (i != replay_index)
664:             {
665:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
666:             }
667:         }
668: 
669:       select_recovery_epoch();
670:       (void)dispatch_locked();
671:       return;
672:     }
673: 
674:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
675: 
676:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
677:     {
678:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
679:         {
680:           release_recovery_slots();
681:           g_recovery_index = 0;
682:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
683:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
684:         }
685:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
686:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
687:         {
688:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
689:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
690:            */
691:         }
692:       else
693:         {
694:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
695:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
696:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
697:         }
698:     }
699: 
700:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
701:            result < 0)
702:     {
703:       begin_abort(result);
704:     }
705: 
706:   (void)dispatch_locked();
707: }

709: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
710: {
711:   struct ack_slot *slot;
712:   unsigned int rx_index;
713:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
714:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
715:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
716:   uint8_t state = 0;
717:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
718: 
719:   g_stats.last_command_header = message->header;
720: 
721:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
722:     {
723:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
724:       if (slot == NULL)
725:         {
726:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
727:           return -EAGAIN;
728:         }
729:     }
730:   else
731:     {
732:       slot = NULL;
733:     }
734: 
735:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
736:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
737:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
738:     {
739:       g_stats.bad_header++;
740:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
741:     }
742:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
743:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
744:     {
745:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
746:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
747:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
748:         {
749:           if (slot != NULL)
750:             {
751:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
752:             }
753: 
754:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
755:           return -EAGAIN;
756:         }
757:       else if (ret < 0)
758:         {
759:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
760:         }
761:     }
762:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
763:     {
764:       ret = g_pwc_rx(message);
765:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
766:         {
767:           if (slot != NULL)
768:             {
769:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
770:             }
771: 
772:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
773:           return -EAGAIN;
774:         }
775:       else if (ret < 0)
776:         {
777:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
778:         }
779:     }
780:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
781:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||
782:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 1u) &&
783:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
784:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
785:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
786:     {
787:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
788:       ack_flags = 2u;
789:       ret = OK;
790:     }
791:   else
792:     {
793:       g_stats.unsupported++;
794:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
795:     }
796: 
797:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
798:     {
799:       return OK;
800:     }
801: 
802:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
803:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
804:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
805:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
806:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
807: 
808:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
809:     {
810:       g_probe_requested = true;
811:     }
812: 
813:   (void)dispatch_locked();
814:   return OK;
815: }

817: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
818: {
819:   irqstate_t flags;
820:   uint8_t control;
821: 
822:   flags = up_irq_save();
823:   g_stats.rx++;
824:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
825: 
826:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
827:     {
828:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
829:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
830:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
831:         {
832:           g_stats.bad_header++;
833:         }
834:       else
835:         {
836:           g_stats.resets++;
837:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
838:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
839:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
840:         }
841:     }
842:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
843:     {
844:       handle_ack(message);

161:    * it.  arm_fpuconfig() does not depend on BSS-backed synchronization.

178:        dest < __ram_vectors_end; )

325: static void bt_ipc_message_handle(void)
326: {
327:     bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
328:     bt_ipc_msg_t msg;
329: 
330:     while (1)
331:     {
332: 
333:         ret = rtos_pop_from_queue(&bt_ipc_env.queue, &msg, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
334: 
335:         if (kNoErr == ret)
336:         {
337:             switch (msg.type)
338:             {
339:                 case BT_IPC_CMD_IND_MSG:
340:                 {
341:                     //LOGD("BT_IPC_CMD_IND_MSG\n");
342:                     //cmd_hdr_t *cmd_hdr = (cmd_hdr_t *)(uintptr_t)msg.param;
343:                     //LOGD("opcode 0x%04x, param_len %d\n",cmd_hdr->opcode, cmd_hdr->param_len);
344:                     bt_ipc_hci_free_pkt(msg.param);
345:                 }
346:                 break;
347: 
348:                 case BT_IPC_EVNET_IND_MSG:
349:                 {
350:                     //LOGD("BT_IPC_EVNET_IND_MSG\n");
351:                     event_hdr_t *event_hdr = (event_hdr_t *)(uintptr_t)msg.param;
352:                     //LOGD("evt_code 0x%02x, param_len %d\n",event_hdr->event_code, event_hdr->param_len);
353:                     if(event_hdr->event_code == HCI_VENDOR_EVT_CODE)
354:                     {
355:                         if (event_hdr->param_len == 3) //init deinit opcode
356:                         {
357:                             uint16_t subop = (event_hdr->param[0])|(event_hdr->param[1]<<8);
358:                             //LOGD("subop :0x%04x\n", subop);
359:                             if(subop == BT_VENDOR_SUB_OPCODE_INIT || subop == BT_VENDOR_SUB_OPCODE_DEINIT)
360:                             {
361:                                 if(event_hdr->param[2] == BT_EVENT_STATUS_NOERROR)//status
362:                                 {
363:                                     bk_bluetooth_init_deinit_compelete();
364:                                 }
365:                             }
366:                         }
367:                     }
368:                     else
369:                     {
370:                         if (s_bt_ipc_hci_send_cb)
371:                         {
372:                             uint16_t event_len = sizeof(event_hdr_t) + event_hdr->param_len + 1;
373:                             uint8_t *p_event_data = (uint8_t *)os_malloc(event_len);
374:                             if (!p_event_data)
375:                             {
376:                                 LOGW("%s, malloc p_event_data failed\r\n", __func__);
377:                             }
378:                             else
379:                             {
380:                                 p_event_data[0] = HCI_EVENT_PKT;
381:                                 os_memcpy(p_event_data + 1, (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)msg.param, event_len - 1);
382:                                 s_bt_ipc_hci_send_cb(p_event_data, event_len);
383:                                 os_free(p_event_data);
384:                             }
385:                         }
386:                     }
387:                     bt_ipc_hci_free_pkt(msg.param);
388:                 }
389:                 break;
390: 
391:                 case BT_IPC_ACL_IND_MSG:
392:                 {
393:                     //LOGD("BT_IPC_ACL_IND_MSG\n");
394:                     acl_hdr_t *acl_hdr = (acl_hdr_t *)(uintptr_t)msg.param;
395:                     //LOGD("hdl_flags 0x%04x, param_len %d\n",acl_hdr->hdl_flags, acl_hdr->datalen);
396:                     if (s_bt_ipc_hci_send_cb)
397:                     {
398:                         uint16_t acl_data_len = sizeof(acl_hdr_t) + acl_hdr->datalen + 1;
399:                         uint8_t *p_acl_data = (uint8_t *)os_malloc(acl_data_len);
400:                         if (!p_acl_data)
401:                         {
402:                             LOGW("%s, malloc p_acl_data failed\r\n", __func__);
403:                         }
404:                         else
405:                         {
406:                             p_acl_data[0] = HCI_ACL_DATA_PKT;
407:                             os_memcpy(p_acl_data + 1, (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)msg.param, acl_data_len - 1);
408:                             s_bt_ipc_hci_send_cb(p_acl_data, acl_data_len);
409:                             os_free(p_acl_data);
410:                         }
411:                     }
412:                     bt_ipc_hci_free_pkt(msg.param);
413:                 }
414:                 break;
415: 
416:                 case BT_IPC_SCO_IND_MSG:
417:                 {
418:                     //LOGD("BT_IPC_SCO_IND_MSG\n");
419:                     sco_hdr_t *sco_hdr = (sco_hdr_t *)(uintptr_t)msg.param;
420:                     //LOGD("hdl_flags 0x%04x, param_len %d\n",sco_hdr->conhdl_psf, sco_hdr->datalen);
421:                     if (s_bt_ipc_hci_send_cb)
422:                     {
423:                         uint16_t sco_data_len = sizeof(sco_hdr_t) + sco_hdr->datalen + 1;
424:                         uint8_t *p_sco_data = (uint8_t *)os_malloc(sco_data_len);
425:                         if (!p_sco_data)
426:                         {
427:                             LOGW("%s, malloc p_sco_data failed\r\n", __func__);
428:                         }
429:                         else
430:                         {
431:                             p_sco_data[0] = HCI_SCO_DATA_PKT;
432:                             os_memcpy(p_sco_data + 1, (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)msg.param, sco_data_len - 1);
433:                             s_bt_ipc_hci_send_cb(p_sco_data, sco_data_len);
434:                             os_free(p_sco_data);
435:                         }
436:                     }
437:                     bt_ipc_hci_free_pkt(msg.param);
438:                 }
439:                 break;
440: 
441:                 case BT_IPC_FREE_MSG:
442:                 {
443:                     //LOGD("BT_IPC_FREE_MSG\n");
444:                     //LOGD("free ptr %p\n",msg.param);
445:                     os_free((void*)(uintptr_t)msg.param);
446:                 }
447:                 break;
448: 
449:                 case BT_IPC_EXIT_MSG:
450:                     goto exit;
451: 
452:                 default:
453:                     break;
454:             }
455:         }
456:     }
457: 
458: exit:
459: 
460:     /* delate msg queue */
461:     ret = rtos_deinit_queue(&bt_ipc_env.queue);
462: 
463:     if (ret != kNoErr)
464:     {
465:         LOGW("delete message queue fail\n");
466:     }
467: 
468:     bt_ipc_env.queue = NULL;
469: 
470:     LOGW("delete message queue complete\n");
471: 
472:     /* delate task */
473:     rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
474: 
475:     bt_ipc_env.thd = NULL;
476: 
477:     LOGW("delete task complete\n");
478: }

485: void bt_ipc_init(void)
486: {
487:     if (BT_IPC_STATE_READY == bt_ipc_env.state)
488:     {
489:         LOGW("%s bt ipc already initialised\r\n", __func__);
490:         return;
491:     }
492: 
493:     bk_err_t ret;
494: 
495:     ret = rtos_init_queue(&bt_ipc_env.queue,
496:                           "bt_ipc_queue",
497:                           sizeof(bt_ipc_msg_t),
498:                           BT_IPC_QUEUE_LEN);
499: 
500:     if (ret != BK_OK)
501:     {
502:         LOGW("%s, create bt ipc queue failed\n", __func__);
503:         return;
504:     }
505: 
506:     ret = rtos_create_thread(&bt_ipc_env.thd,
507:                              BT_IPC_TASK_PRIO,
508:                              "bt_ipc_thd",
509:                              (beken_thread_function_t)bt_ipc_message_handle,
510:                              2048,
511:                              NULL);
512: 
513:     if (ret != BK_OK)
514:     {
515:         LOGW("create bt ipc thread fail\n");
516:         rtos_deinit_queue(&bt_ipc_env.queue);
517:         bt_ipc_env.queue = NULL;
518:         return;
519:     }
520: 
521:     /* register a mailbox channel */
522:     bt_ipc_mailbox_config(BT_IPC_CMD_CHNL);
523: 
524:     /* init semaphore */
525:     ret = rtos_init_semaphore_ex(&bt_ipc_env.send_sema, 1, 1);
526:     if (ret != BK_OK) {
527:         LOGW("init send_sema fail!\r\n");
528:         rtos_deinit_queue(&bt_ipc_env.queue);
529:         bt_ipc_env.queue = NULL;
530:         rtos_delete_thread(bt_ipc_env.thd);
531:         bt_ipc_env.thd = NULL;
532:         return;
533:     }
534: 
535:     bt_ipc_env.state = BT_IPC_STATE_READY;
536:     LOGD("%s success\n", __func__);
537: }

344:        * normally block in the event that there is no available IOB memory.
345:        * It will return NULL is called from an interrupt handler with no
346:        * available buffers.
347:        */
348: 
349:       buf->frame = iob_alloc(false);
350:       if (!buf->frame)
351:         {
352:           wlerr("ERROR:  Failed to allocate an IOB\n");
353:           bt_buf_release(buf);
354:           return NULL;
355:         }
356: 
357:       buf->frame->io_offset = reserve_head;
358:       buf->frame->io_len    = reserve_head; /* IOB length includes offset */
359:       buf->frame->io_pktlen = reserve_head;
360: 
361:       buf->data = buf->frame->io_data + reserve_head;
362:     }
363: 
364:   wlinfo("buf %p type %d reserve %zu\n", buf, buf->type, reserve_head);
365:   return buf;
366: }

368: /****************************************************************************
369:  * Name: bt_buf_release
370:  *
371:  * Description:
372:  *   The bt_buf_release function will return a buffer structure to
373:  *   the free pool of buffers if it was a pre-allocated buffer structure.
374:  *   If the buffer structure was allocated dynamically it will be
375:  *   deallocated.
376:  *
377:  * Input Parameters:
378:  *   buf - Buffer structure to free
379:  *
380:  * Returned Value:
381:  *   None
382:  *
383:  ****************************************************************************/
384: 
385: void bt_buf_release(FAR struct bt_buf_s *buf)
386: {
387: #ifdef CONFIG_WIRELESS_BLUETOOTH_HOST
388:   enum bt_buf_type_e type;
389:   uint16_t handle;
390: #endif
391:   irqstate_t flags;
392: 
393:   wlinfo("buf %p ref %u type %d\n", buf, buf->ref, buf->type);
394: 
395:   DEBUGASSERT(buf->ref > 0);
396: 
397:   if (--buf->ref > 0)
398:     {
399:       wlinfo("Remaining references: %d\n", buf->ref);
400:       return;
401:     }
402: 
403: #ifdef CONFIG_WIRELESS_BLUETOOTH_HOST
404:   handle = buf->u.acl.handle;
405:   type   = buf->type;
406: #endif
407: 
408:   /* Free the contained frame and return the container to the correct memory
409:    * pool.
410:    */
411: 
412:   if (buf->frame != NULL)
413:     {
414:       iob_free(buf->frame);
415:       buf->frame = NULL;
416:     }
417: 
418: #if CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_BUFFER_PREALLOC > CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_BUFFER_IRQRESERVE
419:   /* If this is a generally available pre-allocated buffer structure,
420:    * then just put it back in the free list.
421:    */
422: 
423:   if (buf->pool == POOL_BUFFER_GENERAL)
424:     {
425:       /* Make sure we avoid concurrent access to the free
426:        * list from interrupt handlers.
427:        */
428: 
429:       flags      = spin_lock_irqsave(&g_buf_lock);
430:       buf->flink = g_buf_free;
431:       g_buf_free = buf;
432:       spin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_buf_lock, flags);
433:     }
434:   else
435: #endif
436: 
437: #if CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_BUFFER_IRQRESERVE > 0
438:   /* If this is a buffer structure pre-allocated for interrupts,
439:    * then put it back in the correct free list.
440:    */
441: 
442:   if (buf->pool == POOL_BUFFER_IRQ)
443:     {
444:       /* Make sure we avoid concurrent access to the free
445:        * list from interrupt handlers.
446:        */
447: 
448:       flags          = spin_lock_irqsave(&g_buf_lock);
449:       buf->flink     = g_buf_free_irq;
450:       g_buf_free_irq = buf;
451:       spin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_buf_lock, flags);
452:     }
453:   else
454: #endif
455: 
456:     {
457:       /* Otherwise, deallocate it. */
458: 
459:       DEBUGASSERT(buf->pool == POOL_BUFFER_DYNAMIC);
460:       kmm_free(buf);
461:     }
462: 
463:   wlinfo("Buffer freed: %p\n", buf);
464: 
465: #ifdef CONFIG_WIRELESS_BLUETOOTH_HOST
466:   if (type == BT_ACL_IN)
467:     {
468:       FAR struct bt_hci_cp_host_num_completed_packets_s *cp;
469:       FAR struct bt_hci_handle_count_s *hc;
470: 
471:       wlinfo("Reporting completed packet for handle %u\n", handle);
472: 
473:       buf = bt_hci_cmd_create(BT_HCI_OP_HOST_NUM_COMPLETED_PACKETS,
474:                               sizeof(*cp) + sizeof(*hc));
475:       if (buf == NULL)
476:         {
477:           wlerr("ERROR: Unable to allocate new HCI command\n");
478:           return;
479:         }
480: 
481:       cp              = bt_buf_extend(buf, sizeof(*cp));
482:       cp->num_handles = BT_HOST2LE16(1);
483: 
484:       hc              = bt_buf_extend(buf, sizeof(*hc));
485:       hc->handle      = BT_HOST2LE16(handle);
486:       hc->count       = BT_HOST2LE16(1);
487: 
488:       bt_hci_cmd_send(BT_HCI_OP_HOST_NUM_COMPLETED_PACKETS, buf);
489:     }
490: #endif
491: }

58: static void btsak_cmd_discover_common(FAR struct btsak_s *btsak,
59:                                       int argc, FAR char *argv[],
60:                                       enum bt_gatt_discover_e type)
61: {
62:   struct btreq_s btreq;
63:   unsigned int argndx;
64:   int sockfd;
65:   int ret;
66:   FAR struct bt_discresonse_s *rsp;
67:   struct bt_discresonse_s result[CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_MAXDISCOVER];
68:   int i;
69: 
70:   /* Check for help command */
71: 
72:   if (argc == 2 && strcmp(argv[1], "-h") == 0)
73:     {
74:       btsak_gatt_showusage(btsak->progname, argv[0], EXIT_SUCCESS);
75:     }
76: 
77:   argndx = (type == GATT_DISCOVER) ? 4 : 3;
78:   if (argc < argndx)
79:     {
80:       fprintf(stderr,
81:               "ERROR:  Invalid number of arguments.  "
82:               "Found %d expected at least %u\n",
83:               argc - 1, argndx - 1);
84:       btsak_gatt_showusage(btsak->progname, argv[0], EXIT_FAILURE);
85:     }
86: 
87:   strlcpy(btreq.btr_name, btsak->ifname, IFNAMSIZ);
88:   btreq.btr_dtype = (uint8_t)type;
89: 
90:   ret = btsak_str2addr(argv[1], btreq.btr_dpeer.val);
91:   if (ret < 0)
92:     {
93:       fprintf(stderr, "ERROR:  Bad value for <addr>: %s\n", argv[1]);
94:       btsak_gatt_showusage(btsak->progname, argv[0], EXIT_FAILURE);
95:     }
96: 
97:   ret = btsak_str2addrtype(argv[2], &btreq.btr_dpeer.type);
98:   if (ret < 0)
99:     {
100:       fprintf(stderr, "ERROR:  Bad value for address type: %s\n", argv[2]);
101:       btsak_gatt_showusage(btsak->progname, argv[0], EXIT_FAILURE);
102:     }
103: 
104:   if (type == GATT_DISCOVER)
105:     {
106:       btreq.btr_duuid16 = btsak_str2uint16(argv[3]);
107:     }
108:   else
109:     {
110:       btreq.btr_duuid16 = 0;
111:     }
112: 
113:   btreq.btr_dstart = 0x0001;
114:   btreq.btr_dend   = 0xffff;
115: 
116:   if (argc > argndx)
117:     {
118:       btreq.btr_dstart = btsak_str2uint16(argv[argndx]);
119:       argndx++;
120: 
121:       if (argc > argndx)
122:         {
123:           btreq.btr_dend = btsak_str2uint16(argv[argndx]);
124:           argndx++;
125:         }

132:         }
133:     }

136: 
137:   btreq.btr_gnrsp = CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_MAXDISCOVER;
138:   btreq.btr_grsp  = result;
139:   btreq.btr_indx  = 0;

141:   sockfd = btsak_socket(btsak);
142:   if (sockfd >= 0)

144:       ret = ioctl(sockfd, SIOCBTDISCOVER,
145:                   (unsigned long)((uintptr_t)&btreq));

149:                   errno);

159:               printf("%d.\thandle 0x%04x perm: %02x\n",
160:                      i, rsp->dr_handle, rsp->dr_perm);

60:   fprintf(stderr, "Usage:\n\n");
61:   fprintf(stderr, "\t%s <ifname> %s [-h] <start|stop>\n",
62:           progname, cmd);
63:   fprintf(stderr, "\nWhere the options do the following:\n\n");
64:   fprintf(stderr, "\tstart\t- Starts advertising (type ADV_IND).\n");

69: /****************************************************************************
70:  * Name: btsak_cmd_advertisestart
71:  *
72:  * Description:
73:  *   Advertise start command
74:  *
75:  ****************************************************************************/
76: 
77: static void btsak_cmd_advertisestart(FAR struct btsak_s *btsak,
78:                                      FAR char *cmd,
79:                                      int argc, FAR char *argv[])
80: {
81:   struct btreq_s btreq;
82:   struct bt_eir_s ad[2];             /* Data for advertisement packets */
83:   struct bt_eir_s sd[2];             /* Data for scan response packets */
84:   int sockfd;
85:   int ret;
86: 
87:   /* REVISIT:  Should support all advertising type.  Only ADV_IND is
88:    * supported:
89:    *
90:    * ADV_IND
91:    *   Known as Advertising Indications (ADV_IND), where a peripheral device
92:    *   requests connection to any central device (i.e., not directed at a
93:    *   particular central device).
94:    *   Example:  A smart watch requesting connection to any central device.
95:    * ADV_DIRECT_IND
96:    *   Similar to ADV_IND, yet the connection request is directed at a
97:    *   specific central device.
98:    *   Example: A smart watch requesting connection to a specific central
99:    *   device.
100:    * ADV_NONCONN_IND
101:    *   Non connectible devices, advertising information to any listening
102:    *   device.
103:    *   Example:  Beacons in museums defining proximity to specific exhibits.
104:    * ADV_SCAN_IND
105:    *   Similar to ADV_NONCONN_IND, with the option additional information via
106:    *   scan responses.
107:    *   Example:  A warehouse pallet beacon allowing a central device to
108:    *   request additional information about the pallet.
109:    */
110: 
111:   /* The data for advertisement and response packets are provided as arrays
112:    * terminated by an entry with len=2.
113:    *
114:    * REVISIT:  To be useful for anything other than testing, there must
115:    * be some mechanism to specify the advertise and response data.
116:    */
117: 
118:   memset(&ad, 0, 2 * sizeof(struct bt_eir_s));
119:   ad[0].len     = 2;
120:   ad[0].type    = BT_EIR_FLAGS;
121:   ad[0].data[0] = BT_LE_AD_GENERAL | BT_LE_AD_NO_BREDR;
122: 
123:   memset(&sd, 0, 2 * sizeof(struct bt_eir_s));
124:   sd[1].len         = sizeof("btsak");
125:   sd[1].type        = BT_EIR_NAME_COMPLETE;
126:   strlcpy((FAR char *)sd[1].data, "btsak", sizeof(sd[1].data));
127: 
128:   memset(&btreq, 0, sizeof(struct btreq_s));
129:   strlcpy(btreq.btr_name, btsak->ifname, IFNAMSIZ);
130:   btreq.btr_advtype = BT_LE_ADV_IND;
131:   btreq.btr_advad   = ad;
132:   btreq.btr_advsd   = sd;
133: 
134:   /* Perform the IOCTL to start advertising */
135: 
136:   sockfd = btsak_socket(btsak);
137:   if (sockfd >= 0)
138:     {
139:       ret = ioctl(sockfd, SIOCBTADVSTART,
140:                   (unsigned long)((uintptr_t)&btreq));
141:       if (ret < 0)
142:         {
143:           fprintf(stderr, "ERROR:  ioctl(SIOCBTADVSTART) failed: %d\n",
144:                   errno);
145:         }
146:     }
147: 
148:   close(sockfd);
149: }

1: # BK7258 最终固件构建步骤
2: 
3: 本文记录当前工作区已经验证通过的构建流程。最终固件由以下三部分组成：
4: 
5: ```text
6: OpenVela CPU1/AP nuttx.bin
7: Armino CPU0/CP app.bin
8: Beken bootloader.bin
9:         |
10:         v
11: Beken packager
12:         |
13:         v
14: all-app.bin
15: ```
16: 
17: OpenVela 只构建 AP raw binary。CP、bootloader、分区生成和最终打包均由
18: `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab` 完成。不要手工覆盖打包目录中的 `app1.bin`，
19: 应使用已经接入的 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 接口。
20: 
21: ## 1. 前置条件
22: 
23: 工作区路径：
24: 
25: ```text
26: /home/mi/vela_competition/contest
27: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
28: ```
29: 
30: 确认官方 Armino 1.5 Podman 镜像存在：
31: 
32: ```bash
33: podman images
34: ```
35: 
36: 应包含：
37: 
38: ```text
39: localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5
40: ```
41: 
42: `app_ab` 使用自己的分区配置：
43: 
44: ```text
45: bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv
46: bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
47: ```
48: 
49: 不得混用 `bk_solution_ai` 等其他项目的分区文件。
50: 
51: ## 2. 构建 OpenVela AP
52: 
53: ```bash
54: cd /home/mi/vela_competition/contest
55: 
56: ./build.sh \
57:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
58:   -e -Werror \
59:   --cmake \
60:   -j8
61: ```
62: 
63: 如修改过 `Kconfig` 或 `defconfig`，建议先删除旧 CMake 配置：
64: 
65: ```bash
66: ./build.sh \
67:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
68:   --cmake distclean
69: ```
70: 
71: 实际输出：
72: 
73: ```text
74: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx       # ELF
75: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin   # AP raw binary
76: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/System.map
77: ```
78: 
79: 检查 AP 文件：
80: 
81: ```bash
82: stat -c '%s %y %n' cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin
83: sha256sum cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin
84: ```
85: 
86: AP 必须使用 Cortex-M33 hard-float 配置，链接地址必须与 `app_ab` 的 AP
87: 布局匹配，并且 `nuttx.bin` 不得超过 AP 分区容量。
88: 
89: ## 3. 准备外部 AP 输入
90: 
91: Podman 只挂载 `bk_avdk_smp`，因此先把 AP raw binary 复制到 SDK 内部：
92: 
93: ```bash
94: cp \
95:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
96:   /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
97: ```
98: 
99: 确认源文件和复制结果一致：
100: 
101: ```bash
102: sha256sum \
103:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
104:   /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
105: ```
106: 
107: ## 4. 构建 CP 并打包最终固件
108: 
109: 在 `bk_avdk_smp` 根目录执行：
110: 
111: ```bash
112: cd /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
113: 
114: podman run --rm \
115:   --userns=keep-id \
116:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \
117:   -w /armino \
118:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
119:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
120:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
121:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
122: ```
123: 
124: 该命令自动完成：
125: 
126: 1. 生成 `app_ab` 分区文件。
127: 2. 构建 Armino CPU0/CP。
128: 3. 获取 Beken bootloader。
129: 4. 将 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 复制为打包输入 `app1.bin`。
130: 5. 调用标准 Beken packager 生成最终固件。
131: 
132: 仅安装 Podman 时不要使用会在内部调用 Docker 的 `dbuild.sh`。
133: 
134: ## 5. 输出文件
135: 
136: 完整烧录固件：
137: 
138: ```text
139: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin
140: ```
141: 
142: OTA 固件：
143: 
144: ```text
145: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/app_ab_crc.rbl
146: ```
147: 
148: 最终打包输入：
149: 
150: ```text
151: package/tmp/bootloader.bin  # Beken bootloader
152: package/tmp/app.bin         # Armino CPU0/CP
153: package/tmp/app1.bin        # OpenVela CPU1/AP
154: ```
155: 
156: 实际完整路径的共同前缀为：
157: 
158: ```text
159: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/
160: ```
161: 
162: ## 6. 构建后校验
163: 
164: 首先确认最终文件存在：
165: 
166: ```bash
167: ls -lh \
168:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin \
169:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/app_ab_crc.rbl
170: ```
171: 
172: 然后确认 packager 使用了本次构建的 OpenVela AP：
173: 
174: ```bash
175: sha256sum \
176:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
177:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
178:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
179: 
180: cmp -s \
181:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
182:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
183: ```
184: 
185: 三个 SHA256 必须一致，`cmp` 必须返回 0。否则生成的 `all-app.bin` 可能仍包含旧 AP。
186: 
187: 检查分区和构建摘要：
188: 
189: ```bash
190: cat projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/bk_package.json
191: cat projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/build_summary.txt
192: ```
193: 
194: `bk_package.json` 应包含：
195: 
196: ```text
197: bootloader.bin -> bootloader
198: app.bin        -> CPU0/CP app
199: app1.bin       -> CPU1/AP app
200: ```
201: 
202: 注意：`build_summary.txt` 中的 AP memory info 来自构建过程中的 Armino AP
203: 占位镜像 map，不用于证明外部 OpenVela AP 已经打包。外部 AP 是否生效必须以
204: `nuttx.bin`、`build/openvela-ap.bin` 和 `package/tmp/app1.bin` 的哈希及
205: 逐字节比较为准。
206: 
207: ## 7. 常见问题
208: 
209: - OpenVela CMake 构建产物是 `nuttx.bin` 和 `System.map`，不是
210:   `vela_nuttx.bin` 或 `nuttx.map`。
211: - 当前 OpenVela 工作树是 `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest`，不是旧的
212:   `openvela_bk7258_dev`。
213: - `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 必须填写容器内路径
214:   `/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin`，不能填写宿主机绝对路径。
215: - 修改配置后若增量构建没有加载新配置，先执行 CMake `distclean`。
216: - 最终烧录文件名是 `all-app.bin`，不是 `all_app.bin`。

259: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
260: {
261: 	u8		log_chnl;
262: 	u8		ret_code;
263: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
264: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
265: 
266: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
267: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
268: 
269: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
270: 
271: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
272: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
273: 
274: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
275: 
276: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
277: 		return;
278: 
279: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
280: 		return;
281: 
282: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
283: 		return;
284: 
285: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
286: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
287: 
288: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
289: 		return;
290: 
291: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
292: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
293: 	{
294: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
295: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
296: 
297: 		/* Stale / mismatched ACK. The original implementation just
298: 		 * returned here, which left phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state stuck at
299: 		 * BUSY forever and deadlocked all subsequent mb_chnl_write()
300: 		 * on this physical channel. Recover the channel and re-dispatch
301: 		 * any pending logical-channel tx so we don't lose the link. */
302: 		{
303: 			u32 int_mask_stale = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
304: 			u8  i;
305: 
306: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
307: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
308: 
309: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {
310: 				if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE) {
311: 					u8 pending = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + i;
312: 					phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
313: 					phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
314: 					if (mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(pending) != 0) {
315: 						log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state   = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
316: 						phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
317: 						phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
318: 					}
319: 					break;
320: 				}
321: 			}
322: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask_stale);
323: 		}
324: 		return;
325: 	}
326: 
327: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
328: 	{
329: 		/* clear following header members. */
330: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
331: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
332: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
333: 
334: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
335: 
336: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
337: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
338: 	}
339: 
340: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
341: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
342: 	{
343: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
344: 			break;
345: 	}
346: 
347: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
348: 	{
349: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
350: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
351: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
352: 		return;
353: 	}
354: 
355: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
356: 
357: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
358: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
359: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
361: 
362: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
363: 
364: 	if(ret_code != 0)
365: 	{
366: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
367: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
368: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
369: 	}
370: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
371: 
372: 	return;
373: 
374: }

376: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
377: {
378: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
379: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
380: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
381: 	u16 		chnl_type;
382: 
383: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
384: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
385: 
386: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
387: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
388: 
389: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
390: 
391: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
392: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
393: 
394: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
395: 		return;
396: 
397: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
398: 		return;
399: 
400: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
401: 		return;
402: 
403: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
404: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
405: 
406: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
407: 
408: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
409: 	{
410: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
411: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
412: 
413: 		return;
414: 	}
415: 
416: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
417: 	{
418: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
419: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
420: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
421: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
422: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
423: 
424: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
425: 
426: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
427: 	}
428: 	else
429: 	{
430: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
431: 	}
432: 
433: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
434: 	{
435: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
436: 		return;
437: 	}
438: 
439: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
440: 
441: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
442: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
443: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
444: 
445: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
446: 
447: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
448: 
449: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
450: 
451: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
452: 	{
453: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
454: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
455: 
456: 		return;
457: 	}
458: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
459: 	return;

462: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
463: {
464: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;

469: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;

471: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */

157:           wlinfo("passing CMD 0x%04x (len: %u) to mailbox driver\n",

160:         }
161:       else

164:                  ((struct bt_hci_acl_hdr_s *)data)->handle,
165:                  ((struct bt_hci_acl_hdr_s *)data)->len);
166:         }
167: 
168:       /* Ensure non-concurrent access */
169: 
170:       ret = nxmutex_lock(&g_lock);
171:       if (ret < 0)
172:         {
173:           return ret;
174:         }
175: 
176:       if (type == BT_CMD)
177:         {
178:           ret = stm32wb_mbox_blecmd(data, len);
179:         }
180:       else
181:         {
182:           ret = stm32wb_mbox_bleacl(data, len);
183:         }
184: 
185:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_lock);
186:     }
187: 
188:   return ret < 0 ? ret : (int)len;
